text: Every AI demo video looks the same. Slides, a robot voice, and music from a toy ad.
direction: A little tired and wry, like you've seen it a hundred times.

text: So we built demo. A Claude Code skill that makes the whole film.
direction: Lift: brighter and warmer, a hint of pride. Unhurried, let it land.

text: Give it a brief. It writes the script, acts out every line, records your real app, and lands every cut on the beat.
direction: Clear and even, walking through the steps one by one. Not rushed: a small breath at each comma.

text: Then it checks its own work. Any scene under eight out of ten gets rendered again. Any overlap fails the build.
direction: Calm and exact, quietly confident. Measured pace, a short pause after 'its own work'.

text: Two hundred and ten recorded sounds. Free, and on your machine.
direction: Warm and generous, a small smile.

text: This film was made with it. It's on GitHub.
direction: Soft and proud, slow and gentle, a pause after the first sentence.
